SARANONI BLANKETS

Saranoni Blankets

Signature softness in every size, from grown-up throws to baby’s first swaddle.

Saranoni’s blanket collection spans loungewear-ready adult throws, character-print kids blankets and gentle baby muslin and Lush pieces — all built on the same plush, refined fabrics the brand is known for. Shop Loungewear, Kids and Baby to find the right size and style for everyone on your list.

SARANONI SNUGGLEWEAR

Family Saranoni Snugglewear & Loungewear

Wearable softness for slow mornings and movie-night furniture hopping.

Saranoni snugglewear and loungewear turn the brand’s signature softness into pieces you can actually live in. Think plush, enveloping fabrics with a refined finish: cozy enough for the couch, polished enough to feel intentionally indulgent rather than just oversized.

SARANONI BEDDING

Saranoni Bedding

Soft texture and quiet luxury for the bedroom.

Saranoni bedding adds the part of the room you feel before you think about it: soft texture, gentle warmth and layers that make a bed look considered without becoming fussy. Waffle knit, muslin, bamboo blends and plush throws bring the brand’s fabric story into the bedroom with a more elevated, collected feel.
